entities.summary: Sophie Hunger (b. 1983-03-31, Bern) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bern and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
